about: Synthetic classified ads for the listing benchmark (benchmarks/listing). Written by hand, no real ad or seller. `truth` lists every field the ad states; a field not listed is not stated and must not be extracted.

Kaksio vuokralle keskustasta heti, hinta sopimuksen mukaan. Laita viestiä.
